articles.summary: At JELD-WEN, delivering great customer experiences is a team effort. Our customer service professionals play a vital role in supporting customers, solving challenges and strengthening partnerships every day. During Customer Service Week, we're recognizing some of the people behind those efforts and learning how collaboration, service and a commitment to helping others brings our Together, We Build Better philosophy to life.
articles.title: Customer Service Week: The People Behind Every Customer Experience

articles.summary: At JELD-WEN, manufacturing is about more than just producing doors and windows. It's about the skilled people who bring dedication, expertise and teamwork to every shift. Across our plants, employees work together to solve challenges, improve processes and deliver quality products for customers around the world. In celebration of Manufacturing Week, we're highlighting team members who help drive our success.
articles.title: Manufacturing Week: The People Behind Our Success
